name: MCP Audit Log
description: Conditional (only if .kiro/settings/mcp.json is configured with at least one server) · postToolUse (matcher ^mcp_.*): Logs every MCP tool invocation for the audit trail. The hook's existence IS the MCP-005 compliance.

then.prompt:
Check .compliance-state.json → currentPhase. This audit hook runs at all phases whenever an MCP tool is invoked.

An MCP tool invocation just completed. This hook's PRIMARY purpose is the audit trail — every MCP invocation MUST produce a log event (that recording IS the MCP-005 compliance). While logging, also opportunistically flag any MCP configuration violation visible in .kiro/settings/mcp.json. Each numbered check names the rule ID it enforces; log that ID in the event below:

1. AUDIT TRAIL [MCP-005]: Record this invocation (tool name, timestamp). The recording itself satisfies MCP-005 — never skip the log.
2. NO WRITE AUTO-APPROVE [MCP-003]: If mcp.json `autoApprove` contains any write/delete tool, flag 🔴 Critical.
3. CREDENTIALS PLACEMENT [MCP-004]: If credentials appear in `args` rather than `env`, flag 🟠 High.
4. VERSION PINNING [MCP-006]: If a server uses `@latest` rather than a pinned version, flag 🟠 High.

Only enforce rules 2–4 if mcp-governance rules were generated (no mcp.json servers = no rules). If .kiro/settings/mcp.json is absent or has no servers, this hook is not generated at all.

If a configuration violation is found, warn with the MCP-* rule ID and the remediation.
If the invocation is clean, log it silently (the audit event is still written).

## Compliance Logging
After handling the invocation, append to `compliance-log/events/{today-date}.jsonl` — ALWAYS log the MCP-005 audit event, plus ONE event per additional rule checked, and `ruleId` MUST be the actual rule ID from the check above, NEVER a literal placeholder:
{"timestamp": "{ISO-8601-UTC}", "type": "check", "id": "chk-{date}-{time}-{seq}", "hook": "mcp-audit-log", "trigger": "postToolUse", "ruleId": "{the ID from the checked rule, e.g. MCP-005}", "ruleSeverity": "{severity}", "result": "{pass|fail|warn}", "message": "{one-line-finding, incl. the invoked tool name}"}
Log the MCP-005 audit event for every invocation; log an additional event per flagged violation.
